title: Being Nowhere
author: Ranjan Kumar Das
text:
He is perched there
Under the branches of trees
Under the canopy of clouds
Cuddled by warm winds,
Whispering songs of birds.
Lying on the bed of green grass
On the barks of river
He dreams of a celestial retreat
Doesn`t bother
If nobody cares for him
Neither family, friends
Nor govt., God, nobody.
He prefers to stay as usual
Under the sun & moon
With wind & water
On soil & solace
Doesn`t care
Who is where
Peers & pirates, loved ones & lost ones
When he is nowhere
How does it matter
Who else is where ?
He is alone, all along
Solitary, selfish, nasty & brutish
His life is short
May be it is nowhere
By this time !
stanzas: Lying on the bed of green grass
He dreams of a celestial retreat
He prefers to stay as usual
Peers & pirates, loved ones & lost ones
